title: A finite self-relation gives a field monomorphism at a space point
statement: Let $X$ be an algebraic space over $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ [def-trf-algebraic-space, def-weil-affine-spectrum], with point classes [def-a1-space-point-topology]. Let $L$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $b:\operatorname{Spec}L\to X$ a morphism. Use sheaf fibre products [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. Suppose the two projections $\operatorname{Spec}L\times_X\operatorname{Spec}L\to\operatorname{Spec}L$ are etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and quasi-compact (inverse images of affine opens are quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]). Then there is a field $k$ and a monomorphism $j:\operatorname{Spec}k\to X$ representing the same point as $b$. Monomorphism means injectivity of composition on morphisms from every test scheme. No quasi-compactness of $j$ is asserted.

proof.text: Put $U=\operatorname{Spec}L$ and $R=U\times_XU$. The representable diagonal in [def-trf-algebraic-space] makes $R$ a scheme, and the sheaf product has the stated universal property by [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. On every test scheme $T$, $R(T)$ is exactly the set of pairs $(a_1,a_2)\in U(T)^2$ satisfying $b a_1=b a_2$. This is an equivalence relation and its map to $U(T)^2$ is injective. Thus $R\rightrightarrows U$ is an etale equivalence relation, since its two projections are etale by hypothesis.

Apply [lem-trf-etale-relation-quotient] to this relation over $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$. The fppf quotient sheaf $Y=U/R$ is an algebraic space; $q:U\to Y$ is representable surjective etale and $R\cong U\times_YU$ with the same projections. Since $b s=b t$, its quotient universal property gives a map $i:Y\to X$ satisfying $i q=b$.

The map $i$ is a monomorphism. Indeed, take $y_1,y_2\in Y(T)$ with $i(y_1)=i(y_2)$. By the local lifting clause of [lem-trf-etale-relation-quotient], lift both on a common etale covering $T_a\to T$ to $u_{1,a},u_{2,a}\in U(T_a)$ (successively lift the two sections and refine). Their images under $b$ agree, so their pair is in $R(T_a)=U(T_a)\times_{X(T_a)}U(T_a)$. The quotient map identifies this pair, giving $y_1|_{T_a}=y_2|_{T_a}$. Since $Y$ is a sheaf, $y_1=y_2$. This proves injectivity for every test scheme.

proof.text: The scheme $U$ is affine, hence quasi-separated by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-qcqs]. Its relation for $q$ is $R$ by step 2, so one (in fact both) of its projections is quasi-compact by hypothesis. Apply [lem-sfb-space-qs-atlas-criterion] to the surjective etale atlas $q:U\to Y$. It follows that $Y$ is quasi-separated in the absolute-diagonal sense required below.

source.place: Tag 07S4 (lemma-quasi-separated), supplying the quasi-separatedness implicit in the invocation of 03DZ in 03JU.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-pointlike-quasiseparated-space-field] to $q:U=\operatorname{Spec}L\to Y$: step 2 supplies its representable surjective etale atlas and step 4 supplies quasi-separatedness. We obtain $Y\cong\operatorname{Spec}k$ for a subfield $k\subseteq L$. Compose the inverse of this isomorphism with $i$ to obtain $j:\operatorname{Spec}k\to X$. It is monic by step 3. The equality $b=i q$ identifies $b$ with the pullback of $j$ along the field extension $k\subseteq L$, so their point classes agree by [def-a1-space-point-topology]. This proves the conclusion without a quasi-compactness assertion about $j$.

lean.statement: theorem finite_point_self_relation_field_monomorphism (X : AlgebraicSpace (Spec (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) (L : Type u) [Field L] (b : yoneda.obj (Over.mk (specULiftZIsTerminal.from (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)))) ⟶ X.obj.obj) (R : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) (s t : R ⟶ Over.mk (specULiftZIsTerminal.from (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)))) (hR : IsPullback (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) b b) (hs : Etale s.left) (ht : Etale t.left) (hsc : QuasiCompact s.left) (htc : QuasiCompact t.left) : ∃ (k : Type u) (_ : Field k) (j : yoneda.obj (Over.mk (specULiftZIsTerminal.from (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))) ⟶ X.obj.obj), (∀ T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))), Function.Injective (j.app (op T))) ∧ (Quot.mk _ (⟨k, specULiftZIsTerminal.from (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)), yonedaEquiv j⟩ : PointRepresentative X.obj.obj) : Point X.obj.obj) = Quot.mk _ (⟨L, specULiftZIsTerminal.from (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)), yonedaEquiv b⟩ : PointRepresentative X.obj.obj)
